title: Create and dispatch AISH work
description: Use when work must run on AISH runners: create or approve AISH jobs, add intake reference files or transcripts, run a cockpit execution session (sessão de execução: plan, dispatch, pause, checkpoint). Not for job evidence (use lpm-aish-delivery) or commit-tracked work (use lpm-deliver-activity).
doneWhen: A re-read shows the job or session in the requested state; an approved job stays `status` queued with `executionGate.runnerMayExecute` true until a runner leases it.
authorityCeiling: Job and plan approval, checkpoint and Copilot decisions are [O]; funding is owner-only (lpm-ai-cost).
jobs: create an AISH analysis job for activity <issueId>
cria um job AISH de teste para a atividade <id> no repositório <repo>
aprova o job AISH <jobId> (sou o dono)
run this objective through the AISH cockpit: plan, readiness, owner approval, dispatch
pausa a sessão de execução <sessionId> e retoma depois do checkpoint
anexa este áudio como referência do job e registra a transcrição
retry the failed nodes of AISH session <sessionId>
propose a Copilot action to summarize the project's AISH jobs

notFor.when: work done in Claude Code, Codex or an editor, tracked by the commit trailer
closing, proving, auditing or releasing AISH work (delivery artifacts, DoD audit, release packages, disposition)
installing or starting runners and hosts, leasing or executing jobs, submitting job evidence
AISH budgets, funding a job, pools or AI cost
WhatsApp or operational intake entries to route or triage

references.loadWhen: playbook create-job: create one AISH job for an activity (gate closed)
playbook approve-job: approve one funded AISH job on the owner's order
playbook cockpit-plan: plan a multi-step objective in the AISH cockpit
playbook request-approval: check a published plan and ask the owner to approve it
playbook approve-plan: the owner approves a cockpit plan hash
playbook dispatch: dispatch the next wave of an approved plan
playbook pause-resume-retry: pause, resume or retry a cockpit session
playbook checkpoint-or-cancel: request or decide a checkpoint, or cancel a session
playbook intake: attach a file or audio transcript to a job's intake
playbook copilot: propose a Copilot action, or record the owner's decision
background: AISH roles, job fields, recipes, limits

codex.shortDescription: Create, approve and dispatch governed AISH jobs and sessions
codex.defaultPrompt: Use $lpm-aish-jobs to create or dispatch AISH work for LPM activity <issueId>.
